settings.body: Everything on it comes from two files: the section markup in sections/, and the data in sites.fixtures.json.
settings.heading: This is your home page

settings.body:
A page is a stack of sections. This one is rich-text: one rich text setting and a width, which is enough for most of the writing on a site.

The header and footer are not in this stack. They are section groups — site-level stacks that render in every page's layout.
